name: Convert GTA V mod to PS4

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: "نوع التحويل"
        type: choice
        default: files
        options:
          - files
          - cars_dlc
      name:
        description: "اسم الملف الناتج (انجليزي بدون مسافات)"
        default: converted
      url:
        description: "رابط تحميل مباشر للملفات (اختياري)"
        required: false
        default: ""

jobs:
  convert:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Wine
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -y
          sudo apt-get install -y wine wine64 xvfb unzip python3

      - name: Unpack tool
        run: |
          unzip -q ps4tool.zip
          mkdir -p ps4tool/file_input "ps4tool/cars dlc.rpf One step" ps4tool/Finish

      - name: Gather input files
        env:
          MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          URL: ${{ inputs.url }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p input
          if [ -n "$URL" ]; then
            curl -L --fail -o /tmp/download "$URL"
            if unzip -tq /tmp/download >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              unzip -q -o /tmp/download -d input
            else
              cp /tmp/download input/dlc.rpf
            fi
          fi
          if [ "$MODE" = "cars_dlc" ]; then
            cp input/dlc.rpf "ps4tool/cars dlc.rpf One step/dlc.rpf"
          else
            find input -type f ! -name ".keep" -exec cp {} ps4tool/file_input/ \;
          fi
          echo "== input files =="
          ls -la ps4tool/file_input "ps4tool/cars dlc.rpf One step"

      - name: Convert and build
        env:
          MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          NAME: ${{ inputs.name }}
          WINEDEBUG: "-all"
          PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
        run: |
          cd ps4tool
          SAFE_NAME="${NAME//[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/_}"
          [ -z "$SAFE_NAME" ] && SAFE_NAME=converted
          if [ "$MODE" = "cars_dlc" ]; then
            printf '2\n' | xvfb-run -a python3 7N-RL_One_IRAQ.py
          else
            printf '1\nN\nY\n%s\n' "$SAFE_NAME" | xvfb-run -a python3 7N-RL_One_IRAQ.py
          fi

      - name: Check output
        run: |
          find ps4tool/Finish -type f ! -name ".keep" | tee /tmp/out.txt
          test -s /tmp/out.txt

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ps4-result
          path: |
            ps4tool/Finish
            !ps4tool/Finish/.keep
          if-no-files-found: error
